'sind von Vorteil' (is an advantage) is an inline marker making JavaScript, Java, Jenkins and agile nice_to_have.

Java raw_text is 'Java, Jenkins' so the quote does not resolve to the substring inside 'JavaScript'.
KI-Infrastruktur appears only in responsibilities and is not labeled.
The 'Wen wir suchen' role list is job titles, not skills.
Seniority is none: the title names no level and the posting gives no years.
German is inferred as required because the posting is written in German and says nothing about language.
